One continuous path, stroke 30. The round-five mark redrawn so there is no stroke hidden inside it. This is the default.
Stroke 22. More air, more delicate, and the first to disappear against a busy wallpaper.
Stroke 40. Holds on any ground and starts to lose its counters -- look at the 29 before choosing it.
Stroke 26 with a wider stem and a shallower cap, so the counters survive the reduction. Not the regular one shrunk: an outline mark needs two drawings the way a typeface needs optical sizes.
A broader, shallower cap. More overhang, which is the thing that stops an outline cap reading as a dome balanced on a stick.
A narrower cap and a longer stem. Elegant, and the furthest from the squat button-mushroom every competitor uses.
One extra line for the annulus. It is the feature that says Amanita, so it carries meaning rather than decoration -- and it is one more thing to lose at 29.
Short ticks under the cap. The most information of the eight and the least robust; included so the trade is visible.
